mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_object_deletion_queue (object_key, attempts, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{objectKey}, 1, #{nextAttemptAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempts = LEAST(user_object_deletion_queue.attempts + 1, 2147483647), next_attempt_at = LEAST(user_object_deletion_queue.next_attempt_at, VALUES(next_attempt_at))
